notes.title: Small Update v0.9.561 - The One About Prestige Visualization
notes.notes:
Hey Commanders!

I’ve been AWOL for a bit while relocating as the place I was renting got pulled into urban redevelopment, so I had to move out. Now that I’m finally settled in with stable internet, here’s a small QoL patch to get things rolling again:


 Prestige Tracking: Each weapon now displays a prestige progress indicator. Track your advancement and push your arsenal to elite status.
 Endless Mode Update: If you hold the line beyond the mission’s expected win time in Endless Mode, command will now recognize the base as secured.


As always, I appreciate all your feedback and reports, keep 'em coming! ❤️

See you in the skies,
– Tolga ⚡

notes.title: Small Update v0.9.56 - The One About Endless Evolution
notes.notes:
Hey Commanders!

A few new tools for those chasing pain in Endless:

Scaling Difficulty: Enemies health, damage & armor now ramp up over time. The longer you last, the worse it gets. Good luck.

No Upgrades Modifier: Turns off all upgrade choices. Pure, stripped-down survival.

No Leveling Modifier: Disables XP gain and leveling mid-run. No stat boosts, no new guns, just 30mm.

All optional. All mean. All love <3

Have fun.
- Tolga

notes.title: Update v0.9.5 - The One That Optimized The Boom
notes.notes:
Commanders!  
You may have noticed a flurry of updates lately—and no, I definitely didn't forget to write patch notes (I’m just reading my git pushes retroactively, alright?). Here’s a tidy recap of the recent patches, fixes, and quality-of-life changes deployed over the past few updates. Thanks for your patience and all the amazing feedback—keep it coming! ❤️

[hr][/hr]

🧰 Fixes

Fixed: Briefing on Operation Dune Bastion was always skipped—now it plays as intended.
Fixed: Enemy units now freeze instantly when the game is paused, rather than slowly decelerating.
Fixed: Game no longer freezes for a moment when a new music track plays mid-game—songs now preload more gracefully. 
Fixed: Steam Cloud sync now works—turns out I may have forgotten to uncheck a little beta testing box 🙃
Fixed: Infantry units with max HP/armor no longer act like invincible raid bosses. They now go down as expected.
Fixed: No UI mode now properly hides everything it should: kills, points, level counters, XP bar, subtitles, etc.
Fixed: Modifier sliders (including weapon count) now retain their values after missions.
Fixed: Endless mode now correctly grants currency post-sortie.
Fixed: Leveling up twice at once now shows both upgrade screens correctly, with the cursor present.
Fixed: 30mm weapon upgrade stats (projectile count, max ammo) now apply correctly after prestiging.
Fixed: Enemies no longer randomly stop spawning mid-sortie—spawner had been taking an unauthorized nap 💤


[hr][/hr]

🧪 Known Issues (Still under investigation)

Weapons may get stuck in reload in No UI mode.
The Decryption effect occasionally gets stuck—yes, we know, it’s becoming a meme. Fix soon™.


[hr][/hr]

⚙️ Quality of Life Improvements

QoL Feature: Added a full upgrade overview menu—accessible in the pause menu and post-mission screen.
QoL Feature: Multiple new ways to zoom for better aim: W/S, mouse scroll, right click, or controller left stick.
QoL Feature: Added a Reset Progress button—for fresh starts, challenge runs, or just reliving the chaos from zero.


[hr][/hr]

🚀 Performance

Performance: Major optimization pass—especially around helicopters, rockets, ragdolls, and high-intensity moments. Up to 80% smoother, even on Steam Deck.


💡 Note: Still improving performance further; firing 20+ projectiles at once may still cause some lag, but overall things should feel noticeably smoother now.

[hr][/hr]

🎴 Steam Trading Cards Are Live!
You can now earn Metal Thunder Steam Trading Cards just by playing. Collect them to unlock:  

Badges
Profile emoticons
Gorgeous gunship backgrounds
  
Show off your battlefield cred on your Steam profile!

[hr][/hr]

💬 Final Notes
Thanks to everyone who's been testing, reporting bugs, and offering suggestions. The game is shaping up better than ever because of your support—and yes, I'm still watching that economy rework 👀

Stay frosty, Commanders.  
— Tolga 🔧✨

notes.title: Update v0.9.4 - The One About Riffs and Modifiers
notes.notes:
The grind never stops, and neither do I. Thanks for pushing Metal Thunder to new heights!

🚀 BIGGER, BADDER, & MORE CUSTOMIZABLE

🔧 Difficulty Modifiers Overhaul

    You asked for it! —total control over your experience!
    🔥 Tweak everything: enemy count, spawn rate, health, damage, speed, and armor.
    ⚡ Endless Mode & God Mode (Pick one, not both—nice try 😏).
    🕶️ No UI Mode (Goes full immersion mode—still a work in progress).
    🔫 No Reload Mode (Who needs reloads anyway?).
    💥 Weapon Count Selection (Bring more firepower to your ops).

💰 Dynamic Currency Scaling

    Higher difficulty = higher rewards. Push the limits, reap the benefits.
    Dial up the challenge and watch that currency pile up.

🔧 Armory UI Fixes

    Fixed that annoying scroll bug where weapons just wouldn’t stop scrolling.


🎵 SOUND & ATMOSPHERE LEVEL-UP

🔥 New Soundtrack

    More atmospheric, more immersive, more Metal Thunder.
    Added more than 20 tracks to Metal Thunder.

🔊 Gunfire Sound Fixes

    Used to be that rapid fire cut off your audio?
    Now it happens around 20+ projectiles overlapping—which is still badass.


🐞 BUG FIXES & QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS

🚁 Helicopters Are No Longer Immortal

    Yeah… that was a bug, not a feature. Now you can take them down.

💰 UI Refund System Fixed

    Buying upgrades? Now properly refunds 75% of the purchase price if refunded.

🏅 Prestige System Fixes

    Prestige weapon names now show correctly (no more ugly dev placeholders).
    🔄 Ammo count & sortie count now properly carry over into prestige.


🔫 QoL Buff: Ammo Upgrades

    Whenever you upgrade your weapon max ammo count, it now gives the same amount to the current ammo count.


Also Mac version is now in v0.9.4

🦾 THANK YOU, COMMANDERS!

Metal Thunder is made by one dude in a chair, but this community is making it a beast Your feedback, bug reports, and ideas are shaping this game every single update.
You keep bringing the hype, the grind, and the feedback—Let's continue to keep making it bigger, better, and even more brutal.

💥 Go wreak havoc in Metal Thunder, and keep making this game legendary! 

See you in the skies Commanders!
 - Tolga, Dumbbell Games

notes.title: Update v0.9.3 - The One About Balance
notes.notes:
Commanders, 

Your support keeps Metal Thunder in the fight! 
Every bit of feedback, bug reports, and suggestions help shape the battlefield.
Thanks to your contributions, I'm making the game better with every update—thanks for being part of the mission!

Fixes & Improvements  

  
 Decryption UI Fix – Fixed an issue where the decrypt animation could get stuck on encrypted text.  
 Camera Stability – Resolved a bug causing occasional camera jumps after firing.  
 Bullet Change Bug Fixed – A bug made the game too fun by altering bullet behavior with sortie count changes. That fun is now regulated.  
 Upgrade System Restored – Previously, Gatling upgrades could apply to all guns due to a bug. That exploit is now history.  
  


Gameplay Adjustments  

  
 Operation Thunderfield - Fix – Mission time extended to 30 minutes, as originally intended.  
 Hellfire Fix – Now tracks dead center of the reticle for better accuracy.  
 Weapon & Upgrade System Rebuilt – Entire system overhauled! Some balance inconsistencies may arise, so feel free to drop by our Discord with feedback—most of these fixes and changes come from your bug reports and suggestions!  
  


[center]See you in the skies, Commanders! ⚡[/center]

notes.title: Update v0.9.25 - The One About Balance

notes.title: Update v0.9.0: "Tactical Uprising"
notes.notes:
Hey Commanders,

This update marks a major milestone for Metal Thunder. Before diving into the details, I want to share a bit of the journey behind it. As a solo developer, every aspect of this game—from the crack of gunfire to the roar of new weapons—has been built with passion and persistence. But, like any battle, it hasn’t been without challenges.

Over the past few weeks, balancing game development with personal hurdles has been a real test. Survival mode has evolved into something deeper and more rewarding, but it’s taken extra time to refine. At the same time, I’ve been laying the groundwork for the campaign, making sure it delivers the tactical depth and engagement you deserve. While these challenges have stretched the timeline, they’ve also ensured that every part of Metal Thunder lives up to its potential.

Your patience and support mean the world to me, and I’m incredibly grateful for it. Now, let’s dive into Tactical Uprising—an update packed with tactical depth, devastating firepower, and chaotic new battlegrounds.

[hr][/hr]
⚔️ RTS Mode Enhancements

Unit Deployment with Vanguard Points:
Earn vanguard points during each session to deploy Infantry, APCs, Tanks, and Helicopters. Think strategically: will you fortify your frontline or create a deadly chokehold? Every decision matters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/8d1e7647410dd5f68001b47763cf00f196118c54.gif

Tactical Commands:
Take command of the battlefield with precise orders for your units. Move, attack, or retreat to defensive positions as the situation demands. The battlefield is yours—master it.

Refined AI Behavior:
Your units are smarter and more reactive, prioritizing combat engagements when under fire. They’ll hold their ground until the threat is neutralized, ensuring your plans stay intact.

[hr][/hr]
💥 Seven New Weapons


Prepare to unleash chaos with seven powerful new weapons, each designed to bring unique tactical advantages to the battlefield. From precision strikes to overwhelming area denial, these additions make your arsenal more versatile than ever.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/324aba947e29908d9dd2c4a55ad9c9beb6ae9bbf.gif

Napalm
Lock down chokepoints with a mid-sized payload that lingers to burn enemies over time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/f345868a5d6407a526bfab8840e283c1e2893f60.gif

Phosphorus Cluster
Slowly expanding destruction with all munitions dropped simultaneously, perfect for suppression.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/2ab35e60f87b8a62fa655d59212505e6cdaa5155.gif

Cluster Bomb
Rain small but numerous explosives across a wide radius, ideal for crowd control.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/3be3ea3619f5eeb6ce8289f2b94c2a64a7084119.gif

Hellfire
Tracker rockets with mid-flight redirection for precision strikes on high-value targets.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/35411cfa64d4a345b1e3ddf062683b6ee64ce410.gif

Maverick
Fire-and-forget seeker rockets that let you devastate enemies and focus on your next move.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/2b7acf2fbf050483b3a966e7232b1ad46e6f2ea3.gif

JDAM
A massive gliding payload for obliterating heavily fortified targets.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/1d90652f25019772c3564b41f4586b9197b0bb74.gif

COMET
Overwhelm enemies with relentless dumbfire rockets. While each payload is small, their sheer volume crushes opposition.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/daaa4c942fcbba8c5c0529cd6f776f809d6ada8a.gif


These weapons bring new strategies to the battlefield. Experiment with them to find your edge and dominate every scenario.


[hr][/hr]
🌍 Landscapes in Progress


Creating immersive, tactical battlefields is no small task. As a solo developer, every location in Metal Thunder serves as a baseline that will continue to evolve. Over time, expect more detailed, interactive environments that enhance gameplay and strategy.


Operation Iron Crucible
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/70c25077e4e5e0943dd8db1f4bbf2c5efba60142.gif

A small industrial complex surrounded by urban buildings. Tight corridors and open loading zones create a deadly mix of cover and exposure.


Operation Thunderfield
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/662ed6ed04cf7e694febc99652a0307f069af3cd.gif

An expansive desert airbase surrounded by desert. Vital hangars and runways force you to rely on precision and positioning.


[hr][/hr]
🔧 Quality of Life Improvements

💀 Gore System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192417/2565b4af484dbb9f673de1f33f8c93d469a77237.gif
Hits now create dynamic blood pools and mist, adding an extra layer of intensity to every encounter.
Whether you want the gritty realism or a cleaner experience, the gore toggle lets you customize the battlefield to your preference.

🎮 Key Glyph Integration
A new system adapts seamlessly to your input method, displaying prompts for controllers or keyboard & mouse. It's still in early stages, so please report any bugs to help us refine it further.

[hr][/hr]
This update is just the beginning. From refining survival mode to setting the stage for a gripping campaign, I’m committed to making Metal Thunder everything it can be. Thank you for being part of this journey—it means more than you know.

Let’s conquer the battlefield together.
- Dumbbell Games 💪

notes.title: Update v0.8.5 - The One About Localization
notes.notes:
Hey Commanders!

A brand-new update has landed, bringing you a wave of improvements, fixes, and a special expansion that now reaches commanders worldwide. As a solo dev, I’ve poured countless hours into ensuring Metal Thunder brings the intense, gritty experience you deserve. This update wasn’t easy—it took real dedication to capture every detail in multiple languages—but I’m thrilled to finally bring this experience closer to everyone. Here’s what’s new:

🚀 Major Updates & Fixes:

Achievements Tracking – Achievements now track progress correctly. No more missed milestones; every victory counts!
Lifetime Stats Improvements – Fixed double counting for lifetime wins/losses, making your stats more accurate than ever.
Operation Faithkeeper Spawn Points Revamp – Reworked spawn points to ensure smoother, more balanced gameplay in this key mission.
Target Damage Accuracy – Damage output now accurately adjusts for changing elevations, bringing more precision to your attacks.

📈 Quality of Life Updates:

Vanguard Point Boosts – Now earn Vanguard Points at 5x the previous rate. Your efforts deserve rewarding!
Most Used Weapon Stats – Updated to calculate your “Most Used Weapon” based on kills rather than shots fired, focusing on true battlefield effectiveness.

🌍 Localization Update:

After a challenging process, I’m proud to offer Metal Thunder in multiple languages, each translated with care to keep the intense spirit of the game alive. Here are the new localizations available:

German, Turkish, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Korean, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, Polish, and Russian

Your feedback keeps me going, so please keep sharing your thoughts and victories. Take to the skies and unleash your arsenal!

- Tolga
